state_budget.judgment: state-budget neutral if ordinary-Cross Favored/Unfavored is removed; H3 exchanges one relation axis for one geometry axis

findings.lower_writer: deterministic authored defence-event metadata; no new generic subsystem or operator
findings.l1_l2: identical immediate probabilities and resource length; L2 alone makes geometry active and gives the opponent a readable Upper reply after a miss
findings.height: earned: two distinct writers, two execution gates, and an L2 Lower-to-Upper transition
findings.unknown: legitimate underspecified geometry; no generic Winden required
findings.guards: Ochs is meaningful sourced aftermath and an Upper repertoire gate; Pflug is meaningful sourced aftermath and a Lower repertoire gate, but L2 makes its failed-thrust persistence transient
findings.hart_weich: conditional trade remains: Hart raises Cross survival and favors striker initiative; Weich is flat and favors parrier initiative; neither dominates across repertoire ownership
findings.fuhlen: situational on the multi-objective frontier; pure damage favors F1, efficiency can favor blind reads, and decline remains reserve/geometry relevant
findings.replacement: full H3 replacement is cleaner than Hybrid; Unknown can pass without reviving a second hidden relation system

recommendation.project_choice: PROMOTE H3 FOR ORDINARY BASIC CROSSES, subject to explicit Project adjudication and a separate bounded governing integration change
recommendation.hybrid: REJECT: combines incompatible hidden relation and Fühlen semantics
recommendation.next_milestone: governing H3 integration plus focused regression/dependency repair; then integrated full-duel cleanup before Named Guard v0.2
